title: Convert RewardMilestone/RewardUnlockRecord to @freezed data classes
rule: Naming/placement (domain/state models are immutable @freezed classes; never hand-write ==/hashCode for data classes)
why: Both classes are hand-written data holders with a hand-rolled copyWith/toJson/fromJson but no == / hashCode override at all, so they fall back to identity equality -- two RewardMilestones with identical field values are not `==`. Current call sites happen to compare by `.id` field rather than object equality (so no live bug was found), but this is fragile: any future code that puts RewardMilestone in a Set, uses List.contains, or relies on Riverpod .select()-style equality skipping would silently misbehave. The sibling model in the same feature (StreakRecoveryInfo) already follows the correct @freezed convention, showing the pattern is known and used elsewhere in this exact directory.
recommendation: Convert RewardMilestone and RewardUnlockRecord to @freezed classes (keeping the existing toJson/fromJson as named factory/method overrides if the generated ones don't match the custom snake_case JSON shape).
acceptance_criteria: RewardMilestone and RewardUnlockRecord are @freezed with generated equality
Existing reward_milestone_test.dart suite passes unchanged (or updated only for the freezed toString/copyWith surface)
